cases.note: The bundle as the gate exported it: permit, outcome, signed checkpoint and the stream it commits to. verify_url carries the bundle digest.

The same bundle without its outcome and without verify_url. Still valid evidence of the permit; the verifier says the outcome is NOT_PRESENT and cannot prove nothing was hidden (trust.not_checked lists COMPLETENESS).
One signed field edited after the fact (decision). The receipt hash no longer matches and the verify link no longer names this file.
The agent's intent edited after signing (amount). The intent hash in the signed receipt no longer matches the intent in the file.
Every signed document is intact but the verify link names another bundle. A link and a file that do not belong together are not evidence.
The action trace (tempus.action-trace.v1) verified as a receipt: no checkpoint, so ledger inclusion is in trust.not_checked.
The permit alone (tempus.authorization-result.v1), as the agent received it.

anchor_cases.note: A Rekor proof and a timestamp token for the checkpoint in bundle.json, with the reader's roots pinned: the checkpoint existed no later than anchored_at.
The same anchor with nothing pinned. It is about the right checkpoint, but nothing says who signed it, so no date is claimed.
The log's time edited after the fact: its signed entry timestamp no longer verifies. One failed proof sinks the anchor however good the others are.
The timestamp token replaced by other bytes.
A valid anchor for a later checkpoint of the same tenant, read against this one. The wrapper names the other checkpoint, and so does the logged entry.
A well-formed proof from a log the reader did not pin.
